pattern.description: On an empty gradient green background, a single solid dark dot grows from zero size to its final diameter in the upper centre of the frame, decelerating hard into place.
pattern.why_premium: A minimal single-shape entrance with a fast attack and long ease-out tail resets attention after the previous text card and sets up the next build from one focal point.

build_hint.remotion: scale = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 160, mass: 1}}) (no overshoot), applied to the dot with transform-origin center.

notes: The dot is likely the seed of a following logo or icon build (logo_resolve may fit once the next event is seen). Filmstrip frames suggest the dot drifts slightly up as it grows (camera pan_y is content motion; camera.move none). b02/b03 overlap the same dot and are not separate elements.
